# Mini Java App Configuration - WITH INTENTIONAL CONTAINERIZATION BLOCKERS

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded server configuration
server.port=8080
server.host=localhost
server.context-path=/mini-app

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded database configuration
database.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mini_app_db
database.username=root
database.password=password123
database.driver=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
database.pool.max-connections=20
database.pool.timeout=5000

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded cache configuration
cache.redis.host=127.0.0.1
cache.redis.port=6379
cache.redis.password=redis_secret_123
cache.redis.database=0

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded external service URLs
external.api.base-url=http://api.example.com:8080/v1
external.api.timeout=30000
external.api.key=hardcoded_api_key_12345

payment.service.url=https://payment.internal.company.com/process
payment.service.username=payment_user
payment.service.password=payment_secret_456

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded file paths
app.config.directory=/opt/app/config
app.log.directory=/var/log/mini-app
app.temp.directory=/tmp/mini-app
app.upload.directory=/opt/uploads

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded security configuration
security.jwt.secret=my_super_secret_jwt_key_123456789
security.admin.username=admin
security.admin.password=admin123
security.encryption.key=encryption_key_hardcoded

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded monitoring/metrics endpoints
monitoring.endpoint=http://monitoring.internal.company.com:9090/metrics
monitoring.username=monitor_user
monitoring.password=monitor_pass

# BLOCKER: Hardcoded messaging configuration
messaging.rabbitmq.host=rabbitmq.internal.company.com
messaging.rabbitmq.port=5672
messaging.rabbitmq.username=rabbitmq_user
messaging.rabbitmq.password=rabbitmq_secret

# BLOCKER: Environment-specific hardcoded values
environment=production
debug.enabled=false
logging.level=INFO
